row.title: A second set left ready
row.body: The objects make sense as a backup, but no record identifies what the first set was for.
row.rival_reading: A spare set is common preparation; its presence does not reveal whether the risk came from exposure or failed control.
row.gloss: A prepared pair is left without a clear account of why it was needed.
